title: docs(skills): objectstack-formula eval for a mail amount in each record's own currency (currency:@path)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXVvNqWc3NAaChEvSCx3DJX)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1BfaajCZsT5GLe2M7

Fixes #26940
Ruling-ref: 6512920986

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`: case 8 asks for an `email_template` that mails one overdue notice per `contract`, the amount shown in that contract's own currency. The reference answer is `{{ amount | currency:@currency_code }}`: only a mail template may read the code from the send's data; the stored code is three capitals (`EUR`), exactly as stored; when the template declares `variables`, the path must be one of them or lie under one. `must_contain`: `currency:@`. `must_not_contain`: the bare `currency:currency_code`, `currency:USD`, `currency:CNY` and the no-argument `| currency }}`. Six restatements in the reference answers of cases 1, 2, 4, 5 and 7 are shortened (-160 bytes); every assertion and every fact is kept.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: that file's row moves 1352 → 1506, the row comment quoting the ruling below.
- `.changeset/26940-formula-eval-currency-at-path.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

The eval case, the six trims and the changeset are the blocked round's commit `1c67d742`, cherry-picked unchanged (it keeps its own trailer); the ratchet row is the only new change, as the ruling binds.

## Why

PR #26937 (#26660) added `currency:@path` to mail templates, and `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:450` teaches it, but no eval scored it: `grep -rn 'currency:@' skills/objectstack-formula/evals` on `origin/main` `88d60203c` has 0 hits. An AI author writing a per-record overdue mail could write a bare path after the colon (refused at authoring, `currency-code-literal`), hard-code one code for every record, or leave the argument out, which formats every record in the organization's default currency (`packages/formula/src/template-currency-tenant-default.test.ts`; the card first said US dollars, the reference answer follows the implementation). Nothing caught any of the three.

The file sat at its ceiling: 5407 bytes of 5408, 1352 tokens. The case costs 194 tokens, the lossless trims paid 40, and no further deletion inside the file pays the remaining 154 (the arithmetic is in the blocked report 6488686813). The maintainer ruled on the director's brief, ruling record 6512920986, letter A, verbatim and untranslated:

> 「26940同意，并继续帮我评估这种天花板的价值是什么，为什么要卡住车队的开发进度」

同意 is letter A: raise the row to 1506. The second clause asks the director seat for a separate evaluation of the ceiling and is not part of this PR.

Eval self-consistency (every `must_contain` string in its own `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` string in its own prompt or answer): `cases=8 failures=0`. JSON parses; no control bytes in the three files; `eslint --no-inline-config` on the edited script is clean; `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` passes.

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 60 families on `ee7516b7` (after the last commit, in a fresh worktree after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`); `--ran` reconciliation: 60 accounted for, 58 run and exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite: whole-tree `dist/`): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`. Among the 58: `check-skills-token-ratchet` and its `--self-test` (79 cases), `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:published-files`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check-adr-0087-registration` against `origin/main`, and `check:doc-formula-expressions` after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`. `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` ran green over the 4 packages built here only; CI sweeps the whole tree. No package source changed, so no package test or typecheck is owed; `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` grades `skills/objectui` only, so it does not read this file.
